goal: Source a WHOLE-PROCESS TOTAL ELAPSED time (start to dried, purified product, INCLUDING untimed workup/drying) from open-license references, to unlock a time-based process FIT (a ceiling) rather than only floor-based EXCLUSION, for the two seeded benign preps.

method.harness: smartchem Workflow fan-out (find -> adversarial verify); script committed under the session workflows dir (source-total-elapsed).
method.verify_stage: Each finding independently re-fetched; CONFIRM requires ALL of: real fetchable URL, genuinely open license, the exact quoted sentence present on the page, the value is a WHOLE-PROCESS TOTAL incl. workup+drying (NOT a reaction/step time relabeled), correct transcription. A partial time mislabeled as a total is a REJECT.

reactions.A: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) by acetylation of 4-aminophenol with acetic anhydride, then filtration/washing/drying.
reactions.B: Isopentyl acetate (isoamyl acetate) by Fischer esterification of isopentyl alcohol + glacial acetic acid (conc. H2SO4, reflux), then aqueous wash, drying, and distillation.

findings.source: LibreTexts, Synthesis of Acetaminophen (Experiment), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
findings.quote: Continue heating on the steam bath while swirling vigorously for 10 minutes.
findings.why: acetylation/heating STEP only, not a total

findings.source: LibreTexts, Synthesis of Acetaminophen (Experiment), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
findings.quote: After crystallization begins, allow the solution to sit in the ice bath for almost an hour.
findings.why: ice-bath crystallization sit only; filtration/washing/drying follow untimed

findings.source: LibreTexts, Synthesis of Acetaminophen (Experiment), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
findings.quote: swirl the solution on a steam bath for 4-8 minutes and periodically check to see if the solution is decolorizing
findings.why: charcoal decolorizing step at the start, not a total

findings.source: LibreTexts, Synthesis of Acetaminophen (Experiment), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
findings.quote: When crystallization ceases (15 minutes), collect the crystals as before, rinsing once with a few mL of cold water
findings.why: recrystallization interval (optional purification); final air-drying given NO duration

findings.source: LibreTexts, Synthesis of Isopentyl Acetate (Experiment), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
findings.quote: Attach a reflux condenser and, using a heating mantel, reflux the mixture for 1 hour
findings.why: reflux step only; MgSO4 drying + simple distillation untimed

findings.source: UTSA Pressbooks, CHE 1014 Elementary Organic and Biochemistry Lab
findings.raw_value: 10 minutes or longer (warm water bath, 60-65 C)
findings.quote: Heat all the test tubes together in the warm water bath (60-65 C) for 10 minutes or longer.
findings.why: micro-scale heating step only; corroborates that only step times are published, no total

findings.source: 'Optimization of green ... synthesis of isoamyl acetate' (journal)
findings.quote: the optimum values of the factors under solvent-free conditions ...
findings.why: a solvent-free catalyst-optimization run, not the standard prep; is_total false; open-license status not established

conclusion: NEGATIVE (verified). Across five source families and nine candidate values, ZERO whole-process total-elapsed times were confirmed. The open-license benign-prep literature times INDIVIDUAL operations (reflux, acylation, decolorizing, crystallization intervals) but leaves the workup and drying UNTIMED, so no sound whole-step CEILING is available. Therefore time-based process admission stays FLOOR-ONLY: a sourced minimum can EXCLUDE (too slow for the operator) but can never CONFIRM a fit. This is a genuine limit of the source genre, not a gap in diligence -- do NOT fabricate a ceiling (the anti-fabrication directive outranks shipping a time-based FIT).

corroborated_floors.note: This search independently re-verified every sourced step time behind the ROUND-9 floors in smartchem/decompiler_conditions.py.

paracetamol.components: 4-min charcoal swirl + 10-min acetylation + ~55-min ('almost an hour', read conservatively) ice-bath crystallization + 15-min recrystallization cooling

isopentyl_acetate.components: the quoted 1-hour reflux; untimed workup/distillation on top -> ceiling UNKNOWN

residual: A time-based FIT (ceiling) requires a source genre that states whole-process totals: an industrial/pilot process document with cycle times, a patent example with an explicit run-plus-workup schedule, or a completion-time model that ALSO bounds the manual workup/drying. None of these is an open-license benign teaching prep, so this remains open on the roadmap; a DERIVED ceiling is refused here because bounding untimed manual operations would require inventing operator behavior (not known-physics derivation).
